newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 4.30 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 4.30 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought approximately 4.3 million lbs of beef products for use in the National School Lunch Program and other Federal programs.

Since May 1, when USDA announced an accelerated beef buying initiative to aid the cattle industry, the government has bought about 59 million pounds of beef products at a cost of about $55 million, the AMS said.
The latest award under Announcement LS-48, Invitation 013, will be shipped between October 13 and 26, 1996.
Details of this week's purchase are as follows:
Total purchases since the program was announced:

Winning bidders for the fine frozen ground beef were Barrios Distributing (Ocala FL) 79,200 lbs, Bauer Meat Co (Ocala FL) 118,800 lbs, Emmpak Foods Inc (Milwaukee WI) 39,600, Fresno Meat Co (Fresno CA) 435,600 lbs, Northern States Beef (Omaha NE) 316,800 lbs, Star Ranch (Marshalltwon IA) 39,600 lbs, Supreme Beef Processors (Dallas TX) 673,200 lbs, Surlean Meat Co (San Antonio TX) 198,000 lbs, and Taylor Packing Co (Wyalusing PA) 1,306,800 lbs.
Winning bidder for frozen beef patties with VPP was Service Packing Co (Joplin MO) 475,200 lbs.
Winning bidders for the frozen beef patties 100 percent beef were Robzens Inc (Scranton PA) 277,200 lbs and Service Packing Co 118,800 lbs.
Winning bidders for the frozen beef patties (lean) was Aksarben Foods Inc (Omaha NE) 118,800 lbs, Bauer Meat Co (Ocala FL) 39,600 lbs, and Supreme Beef Processors (Dallas TX) 39,600 lbs.
